in_arabic.name: زِيشَا

in_urdu.name: زیشا

in_hindi.name: ज़ीशा

in_pashto.name: زېشا
in_pashto.long_meaning: زېشا نوم د ښکلې او ځواکمنې نجلې معنی لري، دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د افغاني او پښتني کلتور کې د ښکلا او ځواک سره تړاو لري

data.cultural_impact: The name Zeeshaa holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic tradition. It reflects the belief in inheritance and blessings passed down through generations. The name Zaah, meaning "gift," alludes to the idea of receiving a special gift from family, elders or God. The name Sha’a, meaning "grace," showcases the Islamic belief in how every unfolding event in life is a result of Divine grace and favor. Put together, the name Zeeshaa symbolizes receiving a cherished gift through the Divine's favor.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Zeeshaa carries immense importance as a name that reflects an attitude of gratitude and acknowledgement of God's blessings. The name is derived from the Arabic words Zaah (gift) and Sha'a (grace) representing the belief that all good things come from God. This name serves as a constant reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and that even the smallest blessings are a reflection of Allah's generosity. It also symbolizes the possibility of receiving guidance, wisdom, and spiritual growth, as one acknowledges the blessings and grace bestowed upon them.
